****_The Flash_ #762**** is an issue of the series [_The Flash _ (Volume  1)](/wiki/The_Flash_Vol_1 "The Flash Vol 1") with a cover date of [ November, 2020](/wiki/Category:2020,_November "Category:2020, November"). It was published on September 22, 2020.

## Synopsis for "Finish Line, Finale"

_This article is a [stub](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Stub "wikipedia:Wikipedia:Stub"). You can help DC Database by [expanding it](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/The_Flash_Vol_1_762?action=edit)._

## Appearing in "Finish Line, Finale"

**Featured Characters:**

*   [The Flash (Barry Allen)](/wiki/Barry_Allen_(Prime_Earth) "Barry Allen (Prime Earth)") _**(Flashback and main story)**_ _**(Also as a statue)**_

## Notes

*   The Flash's story chronologically continues in the _[Dark Nights: Death Metal](/wiki/Dark_Nights:_Death_Metal "Dark Nights: Death Metal")_ event.

*   Eobard Thawne is erased from existence by Barry Allen's Speed Force energy which resets his paradox.

*   Thawne's _death_ alters the timeline so that his ancestor, Heather Macy, was never murdered; similarly, it is implied that Godspeed and Commander Cold also never died in the new timeline.

*   Eobard Thawne's Reverse-Flash history will be eventually [restored to existence](/wiki/Flashpoint_Beyond "Flashpoint Beyond") after the [rebirth of the Multiverse](/wiki/Dark_Nights:_Death_Metal_Vol_1_7 "Dark Nights: Death Metal Vol 1 7").

*   As a modern-day ancestor of Eobard Thawne, the unnamed husband of Heather Macy may actually be the [Prime Earth](/wiki/Prime_Earth "Prime Earth") incarnation of [Malcolm Thawne](/wiki/Malcolm_Thawne "Malcolm Thawne") who was later officially introduced in [_The Flash_ #800](/wiki/The_Flash_Vol_1_800 "The Flash Vol 1 800").
